verdict.rationale: Unreal Engine is software that runs on the user's own machines. Epic's license grants access to the source code [unreal-docs-10, unreal-docs-18, unreal-docs-21], users compile the engine and editor themselves [unreal-docs-2, unreal-comm-16], and headless dedicated servers can be run on the user's own infrastructure [unreal-supp-dedicated-servers]. Community users corroborate that the source code is included [unreal-comm-6]. Missing for 10: openly accessible source (the GitHub repo is EULA/account-gated and returns Not Found to anonymous clients per unreal-probe-rt-1), explicit first-party documentation framing a fully self-contained/offline self-hosted setup, and independent hands-on corroboration of a fully self-built deployment.
